title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode17 Together Forever

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's it!
That was really good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the part that used to always trip me up. I finally got it right thanks to your advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's all because you've been practicing so hard.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. You've gotten a lot better, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Shiho gave you a compliment!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're making it sound like it's a big deal.
I give credit where it's due, you know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like I've been making more progress since you joined, Shiho. Having you around gives me extra motivation.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's nicer to have more friends around, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I want to get some sweet praise from Shiho too!
Luka, I'm going to try this part again. Can you give me some pointers?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. With pleasure!
Let's surprise Shiho with how well you can play too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan! Okay, here I go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's so enthusiastic.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... She should take things at her own pace.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're more considerate than you let on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
.....
She has weak constitution. Anyone would see the need to go easy on her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't you tease me too...
Sigh. Let's get back to playing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. A bit of banter every now and then doesn't hurt, though.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew! We packed so much into that session!
It was super satisfying!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were so completely in the zone practicing with Luka, I felt as if you forgot we were even there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Was I, really? Sorry! I got so into it, I just had to work on it until I got it right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just don't push yourself so hard you pass out again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That won't happen! I'm taking better care of myself to make sure that doesn't happen again, promise!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll take your word for it. I've got to go now.
Thanks for the session. Bye.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you too. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's becoming more and more like the Shiho we grew up with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Maybe she didn't really change at all.
Maybe it was Honami and I that did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yesterday Shiho told me that I used to be the type to act first, think later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, that checks out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How to put it... You were quiet and collected most of the time, but if any of us was in trouble, you'd spring into action! Kind of thing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like that time I climbed a tree and couldn't get back down?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, I remember that! I rushed to help you, climbing up to where you were.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And that's how we BOTH got stuck!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. You're right, I used to act without thinking.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And whenever Shiho and I started fighting, you'd make us stop right away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho said the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we managed to stay such good friends because you were always there to defuse any conflict.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, maybe. I just always wanted us all to get along.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so glad you did!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's thanks to you that we even have a band going now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know if it's thanks to me, but I'm also glad we're doing this.
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess I was different in the past.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I used to be more proactive when it came to our group.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My friends matter to me just as much now, and I want to do everything I can to bring us all back together, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel powerless.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What can I do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? One of my notebooks fell onto the floor...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's the old notebook I used to use for writing down my original song lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This takes me back. I wrote so many songs, thinking that maybe I could have Miku sing some of them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Uh... Reading them now, they sound kind of embarrassing. They're too...naive, not to say childish.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Although...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Together Forever, huh.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Ichika. Is it just you this time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Miku, could you help me with something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, anything.
